reviews.text:
I registered my dog, Theo, with this practice when I first got him, so he has been in their care for the past seven years. Over all these years, I have always been very happy with the care and service we have received.

Unfortunately, over the last few months we have had to visit the practice more often than I would have liked, for several different reasons, and today Theo had to undergo surgery. I felt it was finally time to leave a review and express just how grateful I am to have found such an amazing veterinary team.

Everyone, from the receptionists to the nurses and vets, has always been incredibly kind, helpful and compassionate. They are always there to answer questions, offer reassurance and, most importantly, take such wonderful care of Theo. I have always found the whole team to be professional, knowledgeable and genuinely caring, and that means so much when you are worried about your pet.

I sincerely hope we won’t need to be back again anytime soon! But knowing that Theo is in such capable and caring hands whenever he does need help gives me so much peace of mind.

A huge thank you to the entire team for everything you have done, and continue to do, for Theo. I couldn’t recommend this practice enough.
Friendly and helpful staff. The vet was very helpful and informative about my dog.

I called up enquiring necessary information regarding my pet, Paula answered the phone and was very condescending, rude and dismissive! She clearly didn’t want to be on the phone. Made me feel stupid for asking valid questions as a concerned pet owner and potential customer seeking simple advice. It doesn’t take much to speak to a person with basic respect over the phone.

I just want to say what an excellent experience I’ve had with Blackheath vets for pets. My guinea pig had a stone in his bladder and medivet were refusing an emergency appointment to even check him last week. I contacted V4P and they have been amazing every step of the way. They seemed to really care about my boy, and cared for him really well. They were also genuinely lovely people and everyone (vet nurse, receptionists and vets) were really kind and supportive. Made me feel at ease. Thank you to the lovely receptionist too how answered my very anxious call and kept me calm whilst he was in surgery.
Exotic animal vets are really hard to come by in London, but I really would recommend these! Thank you so much from me and Cam!

Turned up today to get my cats teeth cleaned under anaesthesia and wasn’t told how much it would be when I booked it two weeks before. I turned up and was told to sign a piece of paper that informed me that it would cost £850.59 which is completely out of my budget. There was very little help on what to do, and so I had to cancel the appointment. After doing some research today I’ve found several vets that will do it for much less and I feel like I’ve been duped.

I would NEVER recommend vets4pets, they were responsible for the death of my very very loved bulldog Dave who went in for a routine castrate and passed away. CCTV footage shows the vet sitting on her phone ignoring my dog "waiting" for him to be calm enough. Tiny hot room with no ventilation. Very distressing phone call, they didn't even bother to learn my name before telling me my dog had passed. Was not told my dead dog was laid on the table when told to go into a consult room. Was more interested in charges than the fact that my dog had passed away in their care. Tried to get even more money from us by charging resuscitation and fancy cremation options.

I asked for a full investigation, i do not feel that happened as they did not ask why there was no common courtesy of looking up a pet owners name before phoning to tell them their life has been torn apart and their baby is dead. VERY COLD VET!!!!!!!! i will NEVER bring any animal back to any vets4pets. They are more interested in money than the health and well being of the animals in their care. DO not shut animals who are squishy faced in a hot room being ignored before they are put on the operating table that does not calm them.... she was just sat on the phone. Disgusting you have torn my heart in two
Really poor service. So glad I took my custom to Medivet where they actually care about animals and not just money

Answered the phone fast. I called up for a quote for euthanasia for a small animal today at around 2pm. The receptionist wasn't really helpful telling me to email in, I text but no reply at all. Having to find an out of hours vet now.
Our chihuahua recently had a surgery there and it was quick and well!
Great service and very responsive to appointment request.  Thank you 😊 …
It has friendly staff and well stock. Also has it Vets clinic as well.

Just feel overall taken advantage of and really sad. Constant lack of transparency of prices and procedures being carried out, staff don’t talk to each other, have been given vague and conflicting information and recommendations regarding my pet’s health several times. At no point I’ve felt the clinic is more than a cash grab. They haven’t cared for my pets.
Quick appointment, vet very informative.

Mila was really unwell, and the team at Vets4Pets Blackheath were amazing. Everyone is so friendly, caring and professional,they truly go above and beyond. The prices are fair and transparent, and the level of care is honestly the best I’ve experienced. So grateful for everything they’ve done for Mila. Highly recommend! 💛🐾 …

Extremely poor organisation and no consideration for animal welfare.

I have had a consistently bad experience with this practice and would not recommend it, especially for cats or animals with chronic conditions.

My cat is diabetic, and on multiple occasions I have had issues with the supply of insulin and syringes due to the practice’s complete lack of organisation. When an animal depends on daily insulin, this is not a minor inconvenience, it is dangerous.

The practice also shows very little understanding of how to handle stressed cats. There is no attempt to adapt procedures or minimise stress, despite this being basic and well-known in feline care.

The final straw was a recent blood test appointment. I was instructed to administer a sedative/relaxing medication to my cat the night before the test. On the morning of the appointment, after the medication had already been given, I was called and told that the laboratory would not be collecting samples for two days due to the holiday period.

This information should have been communicated when I called to request the medication, when I booked the appointment, or at the very least before I was asked to drug my cat for no reason. I had also clearly informed them that I would be travelling for two weeks.

The proposed “solution” was to proceed anyway, send the blood later, and if the sample was no longer valid, repeat the test, at my expense. In other words, I was expected to pay twice because of their failure to plan.

This practice feels extremely money-oriented and poorly managed, with little regard for the stress, safety, or wellbeing of the animals in their care. I am deeply concerned for pets whose owners may not realise they deserve better.

I've had the best experience at Vets4Pets Blackheath, they've looked after my puppy so well from an emergency appointment to his neutering, vaccinations and general checkups. They are very friendly and he is always scrambling to get up the stairs to see the team.
Always the most lovely and helpful. Also very knowledgeable with my little bunnies, which I have found hard to come by in London. Thank you!

Worst experience ever with my dog surgery.
This place is not recommended.
Thank you for the 5 star review :)

Really wanted to write a review as I've always had the best experience at this location. Took our kitten to be neutered recently and the staff here have been so accommodating, helpful, kept me in the loop and let me know about every detail of the procedure and how it went. When we called for some advice the next morning they went above and beyond to help and put us at ease. Thank you so much!

I couldn’t be happier with the care my pet received at Vets4Pets. The staff were incredibly kind, patient, and professional throughout the entire visit. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure my pet was comfortable and well looked after. It's clear they genuinely care about animals. Highly recommend Vets4Pets for anyone looking for trustworthy and compassionate veterinary care!

We've had a wonderful experience at Vets4Pets Blackheath with our spaniel - for vaccines, parasite treatment, help with long term hip problems and help with a swallowed sock! The staff are always so friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. Millie especially has gone out of her way to befriend our pup!

“I’ve had such a positive experience with this veterinary practice. From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel welcome and reassured. The vets are knowledgeable and genuinely caring, taking the time to answer all my questions and explain treatment options thoroughly. They always go the extra mile to make sure my pet feels safe and well cared for. It’s clear they love what they do, and that gives me real peace of mind. I would wholeheartedly recommend this practice to any pet owner looking for professional and compassionate care.”
A big thank you to Denni & Niamh that are always calming my dog Bobby down every time they are in duty.
We are sorry to hear that you are unhappy with our services. Please email us at blackheath@vets4pets.com, and we will do our best to respond promptly and address your concerns.

Heartbreaking experience at Vets for Pets Blackheath
Our dog Bertie, a beloved member of our family, was admitted at 3:30pm and kept until 7pm. We were told he had a foreign body in his stomach and were pressured into urgent decisions without clear information. He was sedated without our consent for an X-ray and a drip, yet the X-ray was of poor quality and inconclusive. We were then quoted £700 for surgery or £600 per day for medication, only to be told 40 minutes later that surgery suddenly couldn’t be done and we’d need to transfer him elsewhere for £5,000 or take him home, maybe life threatening maybe not?! unbelievable!
Bertie came home bleeding from the read, distressed, with the drip still in place and a bald patch under his neck, suggesting he was prepped for surgery that never happened. We later learned another animal, a cat experiencing seizures, was prioritised over him while he was already sedated and awaiting treatment.
When I collected Bertie, the vet said, “If it’s the money you’re worried about…” — a comment I found deeply inappropriate and offensive given the distress we were already in. We were charged £890 for an X-ray and a drip and left with no clear diagnosis or plan (more than i was charged at a private clinic for me!). We have no idea if Bertie is serious or not and have been left devastated and confused.
I have used Passey Place Veterinary Surgery for 15 years before Bertie and never once were we asked to pay at the time of treatment during an emergency. Their compassion and care were always evident. This experience at Vets for Pets felt like a numbers game, not animal care. I deeply regret not going to a private vet where the wellbeing of the animal comes before profit.
We are now seeking a second opinion and have requested a full clinical report. We’ll be visiting the practice to speak with a manager and senior vet. This experience has shattered our trust and caused immense distress to our family.

Unclear xray attached.

We absolutely love this veterinary clinic! Everyone is kind, helpful, and always smiling — a big plus for dogs who are nervous.
A special thank you goes to nurse Danni, who has gone above and beyond for our dog. She’s met with him several times just for the sake of socialization, helping to make every visit a little easier and more positive. Her calm and understanding approach has truly made a difference.
It’s a place where both pets and owners feel supported. Highly recommended!

The vets, nurses and front desk staff have all been wonderful. My poor dog had a foreign body (pesky grass seed) in her paw last week and we got an appointment quickly, agreed on a exploration and they kept me updated. the follow up care has been amazing, they saw her face to face initially but as I’m currently in the final stages of pregnancy, they’ve been extra accommodating. For example, I’ve been able to send in photos of the wound instead and the responses have been quick and very helpful.
I very rarely leave reviews but I’m beyond happy with the care that’s been provided for us and I fully trust the team.
Easy to find what you're looking for friendly staff.
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Since I've joined Vets 4 Pets, everyone there has treated me and my dogs like we are their only clients. Courtesy and very informative at every stage makes dealing with them a pleasure.

Unresponsive regarding test results for a swab taken two months ago and should take up to thre weeks for full results. Repeatedly told vet will call to discuss results. No call. Was told the lab forgot to return results, but this was only flagged because I chased them. The vet didn't notice themselves. Was promised callbacks that never happened. I'm going through the complaints procedure now. The test cost £290 and you have to beg to receive results.
The vet is really unreachable online. No reply on WhatsApp for almost a week except the auto-message. Call them in the morning and had to wait for 40 minutes from queue 2 and still no answer…

We have had a good experience virtually every time and we've been visiting for years
Today was just his annual jab which she did without any bother at all, and because the flea & worm we used to use wasn't available they gave me handy hints for getting him to have the tablet that I've never ever managed before!!! It virtually all went .. soo impressed.. thank you so much
Wonderful vets look after our kitty so well, answers all the questions about plans and treatment. We use the Pet Plan and it’s definitely worth it ! Thank you for taking our of Cobra so well

Disgraceful company. Administratively inept and acting illegally.

Not only have we received poor care for our Pup, whereby consultations last no longer than 5 minutes, where it’s impossible to reach any form of diagnosis…

They also do not honour basic consumer rights and cooling off periods. See attached.

Essentially I joined a pet plan for less than 48h requested to cancel within cooling off period and they are pushing to charge a £60 cancellation fee.

Genuinely looking forward to legal proceedings for this one.

When I requested a quotation for out Pup’s latest issue they provided, incorrectly a services rendered report, this delayed the insurance and pre authorisation process / treatment.

They have also woefully underestimated his issue whereby we needed to rush him to a new vet with a temperature above 40c requiring immediate surgery.

Avoid like the commercial plague!
If you are looking for food , toys , pet carriers etc, for your animals, here is a place where you can find a variety of food etc   for your pets , cats, dogs, birds , rabbits , hamsters, fishes etc

It's a convenient shop to pick up pet supplies when you need it quick. Staff are very helpful and friendly here, our Frenchie love them. Every once a while they do have good offers/deals that rivals online shops.
Lauren @ the groom room is such a lovely lady. She has been grooming my two Shih tzu's for about 8 years and always does a great job.

I had high hopes when I first signed up with Vets4Pets, but my experience has been nothing short of frustrating. From the very first week, there were confusing charges, sudden refunds and misinformation about the charges and the plan that left me completely bewildered.

After getting my cat vaccinated, I was given a deworming tablet that caused severe neurological effects—tremors and dizziness. To make matters worse, I was later informed that my policy had ended because of an email I never received with the policy number. This left me without the coverage I thought I had.

When my kitten needed a blood test, I was told I would have to pay full prices—£200 instead of the £45 I was expecting under the plan. They offered to refer me to a specialist clinic or have her observed, but I couldn't afford either option.

To top it all off, I ended up paying £60 for a consultation, which didn't even count as a return visit. Instead, it was considered a new vet check because I had already consulted with them twice before.

I'm very frustrated and disappointed with this plan and the overall experience.

Decided to leave the plan after a month use and still had to pay £40 pounds for the terminating it.

Although you have a terrible system, I do think the vets are really competent and helpful.
Such a terrible experience after 3 years with them and I feel so let down. Unable to do the most basic of things - book and   honour appointments. Won't be returning.
